gloss: Moves the lower lip; runs near the lower border of the jaw.
role: Each group moves a different part of the face: the temporal and zygomatic branches the forehead and eyelids, the buccal branch the cheek and upper lip, and the marginal mandibular branch the lower lip.
matters: Temporary weakness of part of the face is fairly common after parotid surgery and usually recovers; lasting weakness is much less common. The risk is higher with more extensive surgery, older age, a cancer, a repeat operation and a tumour in the deep part of the gland.
